blocks.text: Hoarding Cleanout Services in Newmarket, Ontario — Cleared With Care, Never Judgment

c: Reaching out about a hoarding situation is hard — whether it’s your home, a parent’s, or a property you’re responsible for. So here’s what you can expect from us: a private conversation, a discreet walkthrough, one honest flat-rate quote, and a crew that works patiently, respectfully and entirely at the pace the situation calls for. No lectures, no reactions, no judgment. Just a fully insured Newmarket team that has done this many times before and knows how to do it kindly.

blocks.text: The Crew Newmarket Families Call When a Home Needs a Fresh Start

Hoarding touches more households than most people realize — in every neighbourhood, from Main Street to Stonehaven, behind doors that look like every other door on the street. Live Junk Free has spent years helping Newmarket families through it quietly, and the 660+ five-star Google reviews behind our name include many from people who were nervous to make the first call and grateful they did.

items.title: Discretion is the default, not a request

blocks.text: We arrive without fanfare, keep conversations private, and treat what we see as nobody's business but yours. Neighbours see a crew doing a job — nothing more. What's discussed during your walkthrough stays between us.

items.title: The pace belongs to you or your family

blocks.text: Some hoarding cleanouts run start-to-finish in a day; others go better as a series of shorter visits, one room at a time, with the resident involved in decisions. Both are normal. We build the plan around the person, not around our schedule.

items.title: One flat quote, however long the care takes

blocks.text: Pricing is based on the volume we remove — never on hours. That matters enormously here, because it means slowing down to check every box and pocket costs you nothing extra. The figure from your free walkthrough is locked, period.

items.title: We search as we clear — nothing valuable gets lost

blocks.text: Hoarded homes hide important things: cash, jewelry, documents, photographs, keepsakes. Our crew is trained to sort as we go, not scoop — anything significant is set aside and handed to you or the family. It's slower, and it's the only right way to do this work.

items.title: No pressure at any step — including the first call

blocks.text: The walkthrough is free and private, the quote carries no obligation, and if you or your family member aren't ready, we'll leave our number and wait. Many of our Newmarket hoarding cleanouts started with a call months before the actual booking. That's fine with us.

items.title: Fair local pricing — 30–50% under the franchises

blocks.text: Big-brand chains charge premium rates for "specialty" cleanouts and add royalties on top. We're locally owned, price by volume like every other job, and typically come in 30–50% below the national names for the same careful work.
Honest Pricing for a Sensitive Job
Volume-Based, Flat, and Settled Privately Up Front

Hoarding cleanouts are priced exactly like our other work: by the truck space removed, starting at {{cad_125}} for small loads, quoted as one flat figure during a free, private walkthrough. There's no "hoarding surcharge," no hourly meter punishing careful sorting, and no revised bill afterward. Whether the job takes one visit or four, the price agreed at the start is the price at the end.
How a Hoarding Cleanout Unfolds — Gently, and In Order
There's a rhythm to doing this well. Here's ours:

items.title: 1. A Private Conversation First
text: Call +1 647 922 5865 — you'll speak with someone who has handled these situations before, not a call centre script. Tell us as much or as little as you're comfortable with, and we'll arrange a discreet walkthrough at a time that suits you or your family, seven days a week.

items.title: 2. A Calm Walkthrough and a Flat Quote
text: We tour the home quietly, without commentary, and assess the volume involved. You receive one all-inclusive figure — and if a phased, room-by-room approach makes more sense, we'll map that out together. The quote is free and carries zero pressure.

items.title: 3. Clearing That Respects the Person
text: On your go-ahead, the crew works methodically: sorting rather than shovelling, setting aside valuables, documents and sentimental items, involving the resident or family in judgment calls, and keeping the atmosphere calm throughout. Donations are staged separately from disposal at every stage.

items.title: 4. A Clean, Livable Home Again
text: Cleared rooms are swept as we finish them. When the final load leaves, the home is ready for deep cleaning, repairs or simply living in again — and everything removed is routed to donation and recycling first, landfill strictly last.

blocks.text: Hoarding Support for Every Situation Newmarket Families Face

Frequently Asked Questions About Hoarding Cleanouts in Newmarket, ON

items.q: Q: How much does a hoarding cleanout cost in Newmarket?
a: A: The same way all our work is priced: by the volume removed, starting at $125 for small loads, with one flat figure quoted during a free private walkthrough. There’s no specialty surcharge and no hourly rate — so the extra care and slower sorting these jobs deserve never inflates your bill.

items.q: Q: Will the neighbours know what's happening?
a: A: Not from us. Our crews arrive and work without drawing attention, conversations stay private, and from the street it looks like any routine junk removal job. Discretion is standard on every hoarding call, not something you need to ask for.

items.q: Q: My parent isn't fully ready for this. Can it happen gradually?
a: A: Yes, and gradual often works best. We can start with a single room or simply clearing safe pathways, let the resident be part of every keep-or-go decision, and return for additional visits as comfort grows. There’s no pressure to do everything at once — and no penalty in the pricing for splitting it up.

items.q: Q: What if there's money, jewelry or important paperwork buried in the house?
a: A: We assume there is — because there almost always is. Our crew sorts as we clear rather than bulk-loading, and anything of value or significance goes into a set-aside pile that’s handed directly to you or the family. Finding a missing document or an envelope of cash is a regular occurrence on these jobs.

items.q: Q: Can you handle a hoarded home after a family member has passed away?
a: A: We can, and we do so often. Hoarded estate cleanouts combine two hard things — grief and volume — and our approach is patience with both: careful searching for documents and keepsakes the family needs, honest timelines, and a property left ready for whatever comes next.
